### Additional Drug Approvals from Cost Elimination: 20 drugs/year {#sec-additional_drugs_from_cost_elimination}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Details"}

Additional drug approvals per year when Phase 2/3 cost barrier eliminated. Assumes valley-of-death compounds (abandoned due to cost) would have similar success rate to funded compounds.

**Inputs**:

- [Average Annual New Drug Approvals Globally](#sec-current_drug_approvals_per_year) 📊: 50 drugs/year (95% CI: 45 drugs/year - 60 drugs/year)
- [Valley of Death Attrition Rate](#sec-valley_of_death_attrition_pct) 📊: 40% (95% CI: 25% - 55%)

$$
\begin{gathered}
Drugs_{new} \\
= Drugs_{ann,curr} \times Attrition_{valley} \\
= 50 \times 40\% \\
= 20
\end{gathered}
$$

*~ Medium confidence*

### Bad Policy Costs Total (US): $5.03T {#sec-bad_policy_cost_total_us}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Details"}

Total annual US bad policy costs (Tier 1 + Tier 2 with overlap discount). Bottom-up empirical estimate based on specific, measurable policy failures. More defensible than theoretical decomposition because each component is verifiable.

**Inputs**:

- [Bad Policy Costs (Tier 1)](#sec-bad_policy_cost_us_tier1_total) 🔢: $3.92T
- [Bad Policy Costs (Tier 2)](#sec-bad_policy_cost_us_tier2_total) 🔢: $2T
- [Overlap Discount Factor](#sec-bad_policy_us_overlap_discount): 0.85:1

$$
\begin{gathered}
C_{bad,total} \\
= BadUS \times (C_{tier1} + C_{tier2}) \\
= 0.85 \times (\$3.92T + \$2T) \\
= \$5.03T \\[0.5em]
\text{where } C_{tier1} \\
= C_{tax} + C_{wars} + C_{drugs} + C_{tariffs} \\
+ C_{ff,explicit} + C_{healthcare} + C_{housing} \\
+ C_{ag} \\
= \$546B + \$400B + \$90B + \$160B + \$50B + \$1.2T \\
+ \$1.4T + \$75B \\
= \$3.92T \\[0.5em]
\text{where } C_{tier2} \\
= C_{ff,external} + C_{licensing} + C_{migration} \\
+ C_{defense} + C_{prison} + C_{infra} \\
= \$600B + \$200B + \$500B + \$400B + \$150B + \$150B \\
= \$2T
\end{gathered}
$$

**Methodology**: [../appendix/optimocracy-paper#bad-policy-costs](../appendix/optimocracy-paper#bad-policy-costs)

*? Low confidence*

#### Sensitivity Analysis

### Bad Policy Costs (% GDP): 17.5% {#sec-bad_policy_cost_total_us_pct_gdp}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Details"}

Total US bad policy costs as percentage of GDP. Bottom-up empirical estimate for comparison with theoretical Political Dysfunction Tax.

**Inputs**:

- [Bad Policy Costs Total (US)](#sec-bad_policy_cost_total_us) 🔢: $5.03T
- [US GDP (2024)](#sec-us_gdp_2024) 📊: $28.8T

$$
\begin{gathered}
\tau_{bad,empirical} = \frac{C_{bad,total}}{USGDP} = \frac{\$5.03T}{\$28.8T} = 17.5\% \\[0.5em]
\text{where } C_{bad,total} \\
= BadUS \times (C_{tier1} + C_{tier2}) \\
= 0.85 \times (\$3.92T + \$2T) \\
= \$5.03T \\[0.5em]
\text{where } C_{tier1} \\
= C_{tax} + C_{wars} + C_{drugs} + C_{tariffs} \\
+ C_{ff,explicit} + C_{healthcare} + C_{housing} \\
+ C_{ag} \\
= \$546B + \$400B + \$90B + \$160B + \$50B + \$1.2T \\
+ \$1.4T + \$75B \\
= \$3.92T \\[0.5em]
\text{where } C_{tier2} \\
= C_{ff,external} + C_{licensing} + C_{migration} \\
+ C_{defense} + C_{prison} + C_{infra} \\
= \$600B + \$200B + \$500B + \$400B + \$150B + \$150B \\
= \$2T
\end{gathered}
$$

**Methodology**: [../appendix/optimocracy-paper#bad-policy-costs](../appendix/optimocracy-paper#bad-policy-costs)

*? Low confidence*

### Bad Policy Costs (Tier 1): $3.92T {#sec-bad_policy_cost_us_tier1_total}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Details"}

Sum of Tier 1 (well-documented) bad policy costs: tax compliance + failed wars + drug war + tariffs + fossil fuel explicit + healthcare inefficiency + housing/zoning + agricultural subsidies. These have strong empirical backing and high economist consensus.

**Inputs**:

- [Tax Compliance Cost](#sec-bad_policy_cost_us_tax_compliance) 📊: $546B (95% CI: $450B - $650B)
- [Failed Wars (Amortized)](#sec-bad_policy_cost_us_failed_wars) 📊: $400B (95% CI: $300B - $600B)
- [Drug War Cost](#sec-bad_policy_cost_us_drug_war) 📊: $90B (95% CI: $60B - $150B)
- [Tariff Cost (GDP Loss)](#sec-bad_policy_cost_us_tariffs) 📊: $160B (95% CI: $90B - $250B)
- [Fossil Fuel Explicit Subsidies](#sec-bad_policy_cost_us_fossil_fuel_explicit) 📊: $50B (95% CI: $30B - $80B)
- [Healthcare System Inefficiency](#sec-bad_policy_cost_us_healthcare_inefficiency) 📊: $1.20T (95% CI: $1T - $1.50T)
- [Housing/Zoning Restrictions Cost](#sec-bad_policy_cost_us_housing_zoning) 📊: $1.40T (95% CI: $1T - $2T)
- [Agricultural Subsidies Deadweight Loss](#sec-bad_policy_cost_us_agricultural_subsidies) 📊: $75B (95% CI: $50B - $120B)

$$
\begin{gathered}
C_{tier1} \\
= C_{tax} + C_{wars} + C_{drugs} + C_{tariffs} \\
+ C_{ff,explicit} + C_{healthcare} + C_{housing} + C_{ag} \\
= \$546B + \$400B + \$90B + \$160B + \$50B + \$1.2T + \$1.4T \\
+ \$75B \\
= \$3.92T
\end{gathered}
$$

**Methodology**: [../appendix/optimocracy-paper#bad-policy-costs](../appendix/optimocracy-paper#bad-policy-costs)

*~ Medium confidence*

- [Infrastructure Cost Disease](#sec-bad_policy_cost_us_infrastructure_disease) 📊: $150B (95% CI: $100B - $250B)

$$
\begin{gathered}
C_{tier2} \\
= C_{ff,external} + C_{licensing} + C_{migration} \\
+ C_{defense} + C_{prison} + C_{infra} \\
= \$600B + \$200B + \$500B + \$400B + \$150B + \$150B \\

### Annual Chronic Disease Patients Treated: 982M people {#sec-chronic_disease_treated_patients_annual}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Details"}

Estimated unique patients receiving chronic disease treatment annually. Derived from IQVIA days of therapy (1.28T) divided by 365 days divided by 2.5 average medications per patient times 70% post-1962 drugs.

**Inputs**:

- [Annual Days of Chronic Disease Therapy](#sec-global_chronic_therapy_days_annual) 📊: 1.28T days (95% CI: 1.00T days - 1.50T days)

$$
\begin{gathered}
N_{treated} \\
= DOT_{chronic} \times 0.000767 \\
= 1.28T \times 0.000767 \\
= 982M
\end{gathered}
$$

**Methodology**: [@iqvia-global-medicines-2024]

*? Low confidence*

### Clinical Trial Cost Per Approved Drug: $1.20B {#sec-clinical_trial_cost_per_approved_drug}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Details"}

Annual clinical trial spending per approved drug (trials only, excluding other R&D costs like discovery, preclinical, manufacturing). Note: $60B ÷ 50 drugs = $1.2B per drug.

**Inputs**:

- [Annual Global Spending on Clinical Trials](#sec-global_clinical_trials_spending_annual) 📊: $60B (95% CI: $50B - $75B)
- [Average Annual New Drug Approvals Globally](#sec-current_drug_approvals_per_year) 📊: 50 drugs/year (95% CI: 45 drugs/year - 60 drugs/year)

$$
\begin{gathered}
Cost_{trial,drug} \\
= \frac{Spending_{trials}}{Drugs_{ann,curr}} \\
= \frac{\$60B}{50} \\
= \$1.2B
\end{gathered}
$$

*✓ High confidence*

### Combined Peace and Health Dividends for ROI Calculation: $172B {#sec-combined_peace_health_dividends_annual_for_roi_calc}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Details"}

Combined peace and health dividends for ROI calculation

**Inputs**:

- [Annual Peace Dividend from 1% Reduction in Total War Costs](#sec-peace_dividend_annual_societal_benefit) 🔢: $114B
- [Decentralized Framework for Drug Assessment Annual Benefit: R&D Savings](#sec-dfda_benefit_rd_only_annual) 🔢: $58.6B

$$
\begin{gathered}
Dividend_{total,ann} \\
= Benefit_{peace,soc} + Benefit_{RD,ann} \\
= \$114B + \$58.6B \\
= \$172B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Benefit_{peace,soc} \\
= Cost_{war,total} \times Reduce_{treaty} \\
= \$11.4T \times 1\% \\
= \$114B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{war,total} \\
= Cost_{war,direct} + Cost_{war,indirect} \\
= \$7.66T + \$3.7T \\
= \$11.4T \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{war,direct} \\
= Loss_{life,conflict} + Damage_{infra,total} \\
+ Disruption_{trade} + Spending_{mil} \\
= \$2.45T + \$1.88T + \$616B + \$2.72T \\
= \$7.66T \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Loss_{life,conflict} \\
= Cost_{combat,human} + Cost_{state,human} \\
+ Cost_{terror,human} \\
= \$2.34T + \$27B + \$83B \\
= \$2.45T \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{combat,human} \\
= Deaths_{combat} \times VSL \\
= 234{,}000 \times \$10M \\
= \$2.34T \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{state,human} \\
= Deaths_{state} \times VSL \\
= 2{,}700 \times \$10M \\
= \$27B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{terror,human} \\
= Deaths_{terror} \times VSL \\
= 8{,}300 \times \$10M \\
= \$83B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Damage_{infra,total} \\
= Damage_{comms} + Damage_{edu} + Damage_{energy} \\
+ Damage_{health} + Damage_{transport} \\
+ Damage_{water} \\
= \$298B + \$234B + \$422B + \$166B + \$487B + \$268B \\
= \$1.88T \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Disruption_{trade} \\
= Disruption_{currency} + Disruption_{energy} \\
+ Disruption_{shipping} + Disruption_{supply} \\
= \$57.4B + \$125B + \$247B + \$187B \\
= \$616B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{war,indirect} \\
= Damage_{env} + Loss_{growth,mil} \\
+ Loss_{capital,conflict} + Cost_{psych} \\
+ Cost_{refugee} + Cost_{vet} \\
= \$100B + \$2.72T + \$300B + \$232B + \$150B + \$200B \\
= \$3.7T \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Benefit_{RD,ann} \\
= Spending_{trials} \times Reduce_{pct} \\
= \$60B \times 97.7\% \\
= \$58.6B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Reduce_{pct} \\
= 1 - \frac{Cost_{pragmatic,pt}}{Cost_{P3,pt}} \\
= 1 - \frac{\$929}{\$41K} \\
= 97.7\%
\end{gathered}
$$

**Methodology**: [../appendix/peace-dividend-calculations#peace-dividend-composition](../appendix/peace-dividend-calculations#peace-dividend-composition)

*✓ High confidence*

#### Sensitivity Analysis

{{< include ../figures/sensitivity-table-combined_peace_health_dividends_annual_for_roi_calc.qmd >}}

- [Current Global Clinical Trials per Year](#sec-current_trials_per_year) 📊: 3.30k trials/year (95% CI: 2.64k trials/year - 3.96k trials/year)

$$

= \frac{Space_{combo}}{Trials_{ann,curr}} \\
= \frac{45.1B}{3{,}300} \\
= 13.7M \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Space_{combo} \\
= N_{combo} \times N_{diseases,trial} \\
= 45.1M \times 1{,}000 \\

- [Current Global Clinical Trials per Year](#sec-current_trials_per_year) 📊: 3.30k trials/year (95% CI: 2.64k trials/year - 3.96k trials/year)

$$
\begin{gathered}
T_{explore,total} \\
= \frac{N_{testable}}{Trials_{ann,curr}} \\
= \frac{51.5M}{3{,}300} \\
= 15{,}600 \\[0.5em]
\text{where } N_{testable} \\
= N_{combos} + N_{emerging} \\
= 9.5M + 42M \\
= 51.5M \\[0.5em]
\text{where } N_{combos} \\
= N_{safe} \times N_{diseases,trial} \\
= 9{,}500 \times 1{,}000 \\
= 9.5M \\[0.5em]
\text{where } N_{emerging} \\
= Combos_{gene} + Combos_{mRNA} + Combos_{epi} + Combos_{cell} \\
= 20M + 20M + 1.5M + 500{,}000 \\
= 42M \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Combos_{gene} \\
= N_{genes} \times N_{diseases,trial} \\
= 20{,}000 \times 1{,}000 \\
= 20M \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Combos_{mRNA} \\
= N_{genes} \times N_{diseases,trial} \\
= 20{,}000 \times 1{,}000 \\
= 20M \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Combos_{epi} \\
= N_{epi} \times N_{diseases,trial} \\
= 1{,}500 \times 1{,}000 \\
= 1.5M \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Combos_{cell} \\
= N_{cell} \times N_{diseases,trial} \\
= 500 \times 1{,}000 \\
= 500{,}000
\end{gathered}
$$

### dFDA Combined Treatment Discovery Speedup Multiplier: 17.2x {#sec-dfda_combined_treatment_speedup_multiplier}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Details"}

Combined speedup factor for treatment discovery from dFDA. Trial capacity multiplier times valley of death rescue multiplier. Diseases that would take T years to get first treatment now take T/speedup years.

**Inputs**:

- [Trial Capacity Multiplier](#sec-dfda_trial_capacity_multiplier) 🔢: 12.3:1
- [dFDA Valley of Death Rescue Multiplier](#sec-dfda_valley_of_death_rescue_multiplier) 🔢: 1.4x

$$
\begin{gathered}
k_{speedup} = k_{capacity} \times k_{rescue} = 12.3 \times 1.4 = 17.2 \\[0.5em]
\text{where } k_{capacity} = \frac{N_{fundable,ann}}{Slots_{curr}} = \frac{23.4M}{1.9M} = 12.3 \\[0.5em]
\text{where } N_{fundable,ann} \\
= \frac{Subsidies_{trial,ann}}{Cost_{pragmatic,pt}} \\
= \frac{\$21.7B}{\$929} \\
= 23.4M \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Subsidies_{trial,ann} \\
= Treasury_{RD,ann} - OPEX_{dFDA} \\
= \$21.8B - \$40M \\
= \$21.7B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } OPEX_{dFDA} \\
= Cost_{platform} + Cost_{staff} + Cost_{infra} \\
+ Cost_{regulatory} + Cost_{community} \\
= \$15M + \$10M + \$8M + \$5M + \$2M \\
= \$40M \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Treasury_{RD,ann} \\
= Funding_{treaty} - Payout_{bond,ann} - Funding_{political,ann} \\
= \$27.2B - \$2.72B - \$2.72B \\
= \$21.8B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{treaty} \\
= Spending_{mil} \times Reduce_{treaty} \\
= \$2.72T \times 1\% \\
= \$27.2B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Payout_{bond,ann} \\
= Funding_{treaty} \times Pct_{bond} \\
= \$27.2B \times 10\% \\
= \$2.72B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{treaty} \\
= Spending_{mil} \times Reduce_{treaty} \\
= \$2.72T \times 1\% \\
= \$27.2B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{political,ann} \\
= Funding_{treaty} \times Pct_{political} \\
= \$27.2B \times 10\% \\
= \$2.72B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{treaty} \\
= Spending_{mil} \times Reduce_{treaty} \\
= \$2.72T \times 1\% \\
= \$27.2B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } k_{rescue} = Attrition_{valley} + 1 = 40\% + 1 = 1.4
\end{gathered}
$$

*~ Medium confidence*

### dFDA Direct Funding NPV (Queue Clearance Period): $475B {#sec-dfda_direct_funding_queue_clearance_npv}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Details"}

NPV of direct funding ($21.76B/year for medical research after bond/IAB allocations) for the ~46.5-year queue clearance period. Alternative scenario: instead of $1B treaty campaign to unlock government funding, philanthropists/NIH directly fund clinical trials until disease queue is cleared. Funding period is queue clearance time (46.5 years with 9.5× trial capacity), not timeline shift amount (207 years). After queue is cleared, the timeline shift benefit (200B DALYs) is fully realized.

**Inputs**:

- [Annual Funding for Pragmatic Clinical Trials](#sec-dih_treasury_to_medical_research_annual) 🔢: $21.8B
- [Standard Discount Rate for NPV Analysis](#sec-npv_discount_rate_standard): 3%
- [dFDA Queue Clearance Time](#sec-dfda_queue_clearance_years) 🔢: 36 years

$$
NPV_{direct} = Funding_{ann} \times \frac{1 - (1+r)^{-T}}{r}
$$

**Methodology**: [../appendix/dfda-impact-paper](../appendix/dfda-impact-paper)

### Direct Funding Cost-Effectiveness vs Bed Nets: 106:1 {#sec-dfda_direct_funding_vs_bed_nets_multiplier}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Details"}

How many times more cost-effective direct funding is vs bed nets ($89/DALY). Even without treaty leverage, direct funding of medical research is highly cost-effective.

**Inputs**:

- [Bed Nets Cost per DALY](#sec-bed_nets_cost_per_daly) 📊: $89 (95% CI: $78 - $100)
- [dFDA Direct Funding Cost per DALY](#sec-dfda_direct_funding_cost_per_daly) 🔢: $0.841

$$
\begin{gathered}
k_{direct,nets} = \frac{Cost_{nets}}{Cost_{direct,DALY}} = \frac{\$89}{\$0.841} = 106 \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{direct,DALY} = \frac{NPV_{direct}}{DALYs_{max}} = \frac{\$475B}{565B} = \$0.841 \\[0.5em]
\text{where } NPV_{direct} \\
= \frac{T_{queue,dFDA}}{Treasury_{RD,ann} \times r_{discount}} \\
= \frac{36}{\$21.8B \times 3\%} \\
= \$475B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Treasury_{RD,ann} \\
= Funding_{treaty} - Payout_{bond,ann} - Funding_{political,ann} \\
= \$27.2B - \$2.72B - \$2.72B \\
= \$21.8B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{treaty} \\
= Spending_{mil} \times Reduce_{treaty} \\
= \$2.72T \times 1\% \\
= \$27.2B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Payout_{bond,ann} \\
= Funding_{treaty} \times Pct_{bond} \\
= \$27.2B \times 10\% \\
= \$2.72B \\[0.5em]

= Funding_{treaty} \times Pct_{political} \\

\text{where } Funding_{treaty} \\
= Spending_{mil} \times Reduce_{treaty} \\
= \$2.72T \times 1\% \\
= \$27.2B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } T_{queue,dFDA} = \frac{T_{queue,SQ}}{k_{capacity}} = \frac{443}{12.3} = 36 \\[0.5em]
\text{where } T_{queue,SQ} = \frac{N_{untreated}}{Treatments_{new,ann}} = \frac{6{,}650}{15} = 443 \\[0.5em]
\text{where } N_{untreated} = N_{rare} \times 0.95 = 7{,}000 \times 0.95 = 6{,}650 \\[0.5em]
\text{where } k_{capacity} = \frac{N_{fundable,ann}}{Slots_{curr}} = \frac{23.4M}{1.9M} = 12.3 \\[0.5em]
\text{where } N_{fundable,ann} \\
= \frac{Subsidies_{trial,ann}}{Cost_{pragmatic,pt}} \\
= \frac{\$21.7B}{\$929} \\
= 23.4M \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Subsidies_{trial,ann} \\

= \$21.8B - \$40M \\
= \$21.7B \\[0.5em]

+ Cost_{regulatory} + Cost_{community} \\

### Total DALYs Lost from Disease Eradication Delay: 7.94B DALYs {#sec-dfda_efficacy_lag_elimination_dalys}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Details"}

Total Disability-Adjusted Life Years lost from disease eradication delay (PRIMARY estimate)

**Inputs**:

- [Years of Life Lost from Disease Eradication Delay](#sec-dfda_efficacy_lag_elimination_yll) 🔢: 7.07B years
- [Years Lived with Disability During Disease Eradication Delay](#sec-dfda_efficacy_lag_elimination_yld) 🔢: 873M years

$$
\begin{gathered}
DALYs_{lag} = YLL_{lag} + YLD_{lag} = 7.07B + 873M = 7.94B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } YLL_{lag} \\
= Deaths_{lag} \times (LE_{global} - Age_{death,delay}) \\
= 416M \times (79 - 62) \\
= 7.07B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Deaths_{lag} \\
= T_{lag} \times Deaths_{disease,daily} \times 338 \\
= 8.2 \times 150{,}000 \times 338 \\
= 416M \\[0.5em]
\text{where } YLD_{lag} \\
= Deaths_{lag} \times T_{suffering} \times DW_{chronic} \\
= 416M \times 6 \times 0.35 \\
= 873M \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Deaths_{lag} \\
= T_{lag} \times Deaths_{disease,daily} \times 338 \\
= 8.2 \times 150{,}000 \times 338 \\
= 416M
\end{gathered}
$$

**Methodology**: [../appendix/invisible-graveyard#daly-calculation](../appendix/invisible-graveyard#daly-calculation)

*~ Medium confidence*

= 416M \times 6 \times 0.35 \\
= 873M \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Deaths_{lag} \\
= T_{lag} \times Deaths_{disease,daily} \times 338 \\
= 8.2 \times 150{,}000 \times 338 \\

### Decentralized Framework for Drug Assessment Annual Net Savings (R&D Only): $58.6B {#sec-dfda_net_savings_rd_only_annual}

- [Total Annual Decentralized Framework for Drug Assessment Operational Costs](#sec-dfda_annual_opex) 🔢: $40M

$$
\begin{gathered}
Savings_{RD,ann} \\
= Benefit_{RD,ann} - OPEX_{dFDA} \\
= \$58.6B - \$40M \\
= \$58.6B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Benefit_{RD,ann} \\
= Spending_{trials} \times Reduce_{pct} \\
= \$60B \times 97.7\% \\
= \$58.6B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Reduce_{pct} \\
= 1 - \frac{Cost_{pragmatic,pt}}{Cost_{P3,pt}} \\
= 1 - \frac{\$929}{\$41K} \\
= 97.7\% \\[0.5em]
\text{where } OPEX_{dFDA} \\
= Cost_{platform} + Cost_{staff} + Cost_{infra} \\
+ Cost_{regulatory} + Cost_{community} \\
= \$15M + \$10M + \$8M + \$5M + \$2M \\
= \$40M
\end{gathered}

### dFDA Queue Clearance Time: 36 years {#sec-dfda_queue_clearance_years}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Details"}

Years to treat all currently untreatable diseases with dFDA implementation. Queue clearance time divided by trial capacity multiplier.

**Inputs**:

- [Status Quo Queue Clearance Time](#sec-status_quo_queue_clearance_years) 🔢: 443 years
- [Trial Capacity Multiplier](#sec-dfda_trial_capacity_multiplier) 🔢: 12.3:1

$$
\begin{gathered}
T_{queue,dFDA} = \frac{T_{queue,SQ}}{k_{capacity}} = \frac{443}{12.3} = 36 \\[0.5em]
\text{where } T_{queue,SQ} = \frac{N_{untreated}}{Treatments_{new,ann}} = \frac{6{,}650}{15} = 443 \\[0.5em]
\text{where } N_{untreated} = N_{rare} \times 0.95 = 7{,}000 \times 0.95 = 6{,}650 \\[0.5em]
\text{where } k_{capacity} = \frac{N_{fundable,ann}}{Slots_{curr}} = \frac{23.4M}{1.9M} = 12.3 \\[0.5em]
\text{where } N_{fundable,ann} \\
= \frac{Subsidies_{trial,ann}}{Cost_{pragmatic,pt}} \\
= \frac{\$21.7B}{\$929} \\
= 23.4M \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Subsidies_{trial,ann} \\
= Treasury_{RD,ann} - OPEX_{dFDA} \\
= \$21.8B - \$40M \\
= \$21.7B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } OPEX_{dFDA} \\
= Cost_{platform} + Cost_{staff} + Cost_{infra} \\
+ Cost_{regulatory} + Cost_{community} \\
= \$15M + \$10M + \$8M + \$5M + \$2M \\
= \$40M \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Treasury_{RD,ann} \\
= Funding_{treaty} - Payout_{bond,ann} - Funding_{political,ann} \\
= \$27.2B - \$2.72B - \$2.72B \\
= \$21.8B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{treaty} \\
= Spending_{mil} \times Reduce_{treaty} \\
= \$2.72T \times 1\% \\
= \$27.2B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Payout_{bond,ann} \\
= Funding_{treaty} \times Pct_{bond} \\
= \$27.2B \times 10\% \\
= \$2.72B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{treaty} \\
= Spending_{mil} \times Reduce_{treaty} \\
= \$2.72T \times 1\% \\
= \$27.2B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{political,ann} \\
= Funding_{treaty} \times Pct_{political} \\
= \$27.2B \times 10\% \\
= \$2.72B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{treaty} \\
= Spending_{mil} \times Reduce_{treaty} \\
= \$2.72T \times 1\% \\
= \$27.2B
\end{gathered}
$$

*? Low confidence*

#### Sensitivity Analysis

### Total Exploration Time (dFDA): 1.27k years {#sec-dfda_total_exploration_years}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Details"}

Years to test all therapeutic combinations (known safe + emerging modalities) with dFDA capacity

**Inputs**:

- [Total Testable Therapeutic Space](#sec-total_testable_therapeutic_combinations) 🔢: 51.5M combinations
- [Decentralized Framework for Drug Assessment Maximum Trials per Year](#sec-dfda_trials_per_year_capacity) 🔢: 40.6k trials/year

$$
\begin{gathered}
T_{explore,dFDA} \\
= \frac{N_{testable}}{Capacity_{trials}} \\
= \frac{51.5M}{40{,}600} \\
= 1{,}270 \\[0.5em]
\text{where } N_{testable} \\
= N_{combos} + N_{emerging} \\
= 9.5M + 42M \\
= 51.5M \\[0.5em]
\text{where } N_{combos} \\
= N_{safe} \times N_{diseases,trial} \\
= 9{,}500 \times 1{,}000 \\
= 9.5M \\[0.5em]
\text{where } N_{emerging} \\
= Combos_{gene} + Combos_{mRNA} + Combos_{epi} + Combos_{cell} \\
= 20M + 20M + 1.5M + 500{,}000 \\
= 42M \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Combos_{gene} \\
= N_{genes} \times N_{diseases,trial} \\
= 20{,}000 \times 1{,}000 \\
= 20M \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Combos_{mRNA} \\
= N_{genes} \times N_{diseases,trial} \\
= 20{,}000 \times 1{,}000 \\
= 20M \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Combos_{epi} \\
= N_{epi} \times N_{diseases,trial} \\
= 1{,}500 \times 1{,}000 \\
= 1.5M \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Combos_{cell} \\
= N_{cell} \times N_{diseases,trial} \\
= 500 \times 1{,}000 \\
= 500{,}000 \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Capacity_{trials} \\
= Trials_{ann,curr} \times k_{capacity} \\
= 3{,}300 \times 12.3 \\
= 40{,}600 \\[0.5em]
\text{where } k_{capacity} = \frac{N_{fundable,ann}}{Slots_{curr}} = \frac{23.4M}{1.9M} = 12.3 \\[0.5em]
\text{where } N_{fundable,ann} \\
= \frac{Subsidies_{trial,ann}}{Cost_{pragmatic,pt}} \\
= \frac{\$21.7B}{\$929} \\
= 23.4M \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Subsidies_{trial,ann} \\
= Treasury_{RD,ann} - OPEX_{dFDA} \\
= \$21.8B - \$40M \\
= \$21.7B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } OPEX_{dFDA} \\
= Cost_{platform} + Cost_{staff} + Cost_{infra} \\
+ Cost_{regulatory} + Cost_{community} \\
= \$15M + \$10M + \$8M + \$5M + \$2M \\
= \$40M \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Treasury_{RD,ann} \\
= Funding_{treaty} - Payout_{bond,ann} - Funding_{political,ann} \\
= \$27.2B - \$2.72B - \$2.72B \\
= \$21.8B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{treaty} \\
= Spending_{mil} \times Reduce_{treaty} \\
= \$2.72T \times 1\% \\
= \$27.2B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Payout_{bond,ann} \\
= Funding_{treaty} \times Pct_{bond} \\
= \$27.2B \times 10\% \\
= \$2.72B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{treaty} \\
= Spending_{mil} \times Reduce_{treaty} \\
= \$2.72T \times 1\% \\
= \$27.2B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{political,ann} \\
= Funding_{treaty} \times Pct_{political} \\
= \$27.2B \times 10\% \\
= \$2.72B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{treaty} \\
= Spending_{mil} \times Reduce_{treaty} \\
= \$2.72T \times 1\% \\
= \$27.2B
\end{gathered}
$$

*✓ High confidence*

$$

= 543B \\[0.5em]

= T_{first,SQ} \times \left(1 - \frac{1}{k_{capacity}}\right) \\

\text{where } N_{fundable,ann} \\
= \frac{Subsidies_{trial,ann}}{Cost_{pragmatic,pt}} \\
= \frac{\$21.7B}{\$929} \\
= 23.4M \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Subsidies_{trial,ann} \\

= \$21.8B - \$40M \\

\text{where } OPEX_{dFDA} \\

= \$2.72T \times 1\% \\
= \$27.2B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Payout_{bond,ann} \\

= \$27.2B \times 10\% \\
= \$2.72B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{treaty} \\

= \$2.72T \times 1\% \\
= \$27.2B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{political,ann} \\
= Funding_{treaty} \times Pct_{political} \\
= \$27.2B \times 10\% \\
= \$2.72B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{treaty} \\

### dFDA Trial Cost Reduction Factor: 44.1x {#sec-dfda_trial_cost_reduction_factor}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Details"}

Cost reduction factor projected for dFDA pragmatic trials ($41K traditional / $1,200 dFDA = 34x)

### dFDA Trial Cost Reduction Percentage: 97.7% {#sec-dfda_trial_cost_reduction_pct}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Details"}

Trial cost reduction percentage: (traditional - dFDA) / traditional = ($41K - $1.2K) / $41K = 97%

**Inputs**:

- [dFDA Pragmatic Trial Cost per Patient](#sec-dfda_pragmatic_trial_cost_per_patient) 📊: $929 (95% CI: $97 - $3K)
- [Phase 3 Cost per Patient](#sec-traditional_phase3_cost_per_patient) 📊: $41K (95% CI: $20K - $120K)

$$
\begin{gathered}
Reduce_{pct} \\
= 1 - \frac{Cost_{pragmatic,pt}}{Cost_{P3,pt}} \\
= 1 - \frac{\$929}{\$41K} \\
= 97.7\%
\end{gathered}
$$

**Inputs**:

- [dFDA Pragmatic Trial Cost per Patient](#sec-dfda_pragmatic_trial_cost_per_patient) 📊: $929 (95% CI: $97 - $3K)

$$
\begin{gathered}
N_{fundable,ann} \\
= \frac{Subsidies_{trial,ann}}{Cost_{pragmatic,pt}} \\
= \frac{\$21.7B}{\$929} \\
= 23.4M \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Subsidies_{trial,ann} \\
= Treasury_{RD,ann} - OPEX_{dFDA} \\
= \$21.8B - \$40M \\
= \$21.7B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } OPEX_{dFDA} \\
= Cost_{platform} + Cost_{staff} + Cost_{infra} \\
+ Cost_{regulatory} + Cost_{community} \\
= \$15M + \$10M + \$8M + \$5M + \$2M \\
= \$40M \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Treasury_{RD,ann} \\
= Funding_{treaty} - Payout_{bond,ann} - Funding_{political,ann} \\
= \$27.2B - \$2.72B - \$2.72B \\
= \$21.8B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{treaty} \\
= Spending_{mil} \times Reduce_{treaty} \\
= \$2.72T \times 1\% \\
= \$27.2B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Payout_{bond,ann} \\
= Funding_{treaty} \times Pct_{bond} \\
= \$27.2B \times 10\% \\
= \$2.72B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{treaty} \\
= Spending_{mil} \times Reduce_{treaty} \\
= \$2.72T \times 1\% \\
= \$27.2B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{political,ann} \\
= Funding_{treaty} \times Pct_{political} \\
= \$27.2B \times 10\% \\
= \$2.72B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{treaty} \\
= Spending_{mil} \times Reduce_{treaty} \\
= \$2.72T \times 1\% \\
= \$27.2B
\end{gathered}
$$

### Cumulative Efficacy Testing Cost (1962-2024): $4.84T {#sec-efficacy_lag_cumulative_excess_cost}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Details"}

Cumulative Phase 2/3 efficacy testing cost since 1962. Uses direct Phase 2/3 cost ($1.56B per drug) - this is a LOWER BOUND because it excludes opportunity cost of 8.2-year delays, compounds abandoned due to cost barrier, and regulatory overhead. Comparable to the $8 trillion spent on post-9/11 wars.

- [Pharma Phase 2/3 Cost Barrier Per Drug](#sec-pharma_phase_2_3_cost_barrier): $1.56B (SE: ±$200M)

$$
\begin{gathered}
Cost_{eff,cumul} \\
= Cost_{P2+P3} \times N_{drugs,62} \\
= \$1.56B \times 3{,}100 \\
= \$4.84T \\[0.5em]
\text{where } N_{drugs,62} = Drugs_{ann,curr} \times 62 = 50 \times 62 = 3{,}100
\end{gathered}
$$

### Efficacy Lag Deaths (9/11 Equivalents): 34.1k 9/11s {#sec-efficacy_lag_deaths_911_equivalents}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Details"}

Total deaths from efficacy lag expressed in 9/11 equivalents. Makes the mortality cost viscerally understandable: how many September 11ths worth of deaths did the 1962 efficacy requirements cause?

**Inputs**:

- [Total Deaths from Historical Progress Delays](#sec-existing_drugs_efficacy_lag_deaths_total) 🔢: 102M deaths
- [September 11 Deaths](#sec-sept_11_deaths) 📊: 2.98k people

$$
\begin{gathered}
N_{9/11,equiv} = \frac{Deaths_{lag,total}}{N_{9/11}} = \frac{102M}{2{,}980} = 34{,}100 \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Deaths_{lag,total} \\
= Lives_{saved,annual} \times T_{lag} \\
= 12.4M \times 8.2 \\
= 102M \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Lives_{saved,annual} = \frac{LY_{saved,annual}}{T_{ext}} = \frac{149M}{12} = 12.4M
\end{gathered}
$$

**Methodology**: [../appendix/invisible-graveyard#scale](../appendix/invisible-graveyard#scale)

### Treatment Delay YLD - Annual: 2.01B DALYs {#sec-efficacy_lag_treatment_delay_yld_annual}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Details"}

Annual YLD from treatment delay: patients receiving chronic disease treatment would have collectively avoided this disability if treatments were available 8.2 years earlier. Represents morbidity burden for treatment beneficiaries (distinct from mortality burden).

**Inputs**:

- [Annual Chronic Disease Patients Treated](#sec-chronic_disease_treated_patients_annual) 🔢: 982M people
- [Regulatory Delay for Efficacy Testing Post-Safety Verification](#sec-efficacy_lag_years) 📊: 8.2 years (SE: ±2 years)
- [Treatment Disability Reduction](#sec-treatment_disability_reduction) 📊: 0.25 weight (95% CI: 0.15 weight - 0.35 weight)

$$
\begin{gathered}
YLD_{treat\_delay} \\
= N_{treated} \times T_{lag} \times \Delta DW_{treat} \\
= 982M \times 8.2 \times 0.25 \\
= 2.01B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } N_{treated} \\
= DOT_{chronic} \times 0.000767 \\
= 1.28T \times 0.000767 \\
= 982M
\end{gathered}
$$

**Methodology**: [../appendix/invisible-graveyard#treatment-morbidity](../appendix/invisible-graveyard#treatment-morbidity)

### Total Deaths from Historical Progress Delays: 102M deaths {#sec-existing_drugs_efficacy_lag_deaths_total}

Total deaths from delaying existing drugs over 8.2-year efficacy lag. One-time impact of eliminating Phase 2-4 testing delay for drugs already approved 1962-2024. Based on Lichtenberg (2019) estimate of 12M lives saved annually × 8.2 years efficacy lag. Excludes innovation acceleration effects.

**Inputs**:

- [Annual Lives Saved by Pharmaceuticals](#sec-pharma_lives_saved_annual) 🔢: 12.4M deaths
- [Regulatory Delay for Efficacy Testing Post-Safety Verification](#sec-efficacy_lag_years) 📊: 8.2 years (SE: ±2 years)

$$
\begin{gathered}
Deaths_{lag,total} \\
= Lives_{saved,annual} \times T_{lag} \\
= 12.4M \times 8.2 \\
= 102M \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Lives_{saved,annual} = \frac{LY_{saved,annual}}{T_{ext}} = \frac{149M}{12} = 12.4M
\end{gathered}
$$

**Methodology**: [../appendix/invisible-graveyard#historical-progress](../appendix/invisible-graveyard#historical-progress)

### Total Economic Loss from Historical Progress Delays: $259T {#sec-existing_drugs_efficacy_lag_economic_loss}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Details"}

Total economic loss from delaying existing drugs over 8.2-year efficacy lag. One-time benefit of eliminating Phase 2-4 delay. Excludes innovation acceleration effects.

**Inputs**:

- [Global Life Expectancy (2024)](#sec-global_life_expectancy_2024) 📊: 79 years (SE: ±2 years)
- [Total Deaths from Historical Progress Delays](#sec-existing_drugs_efficacy_lag_deaths_total) 🔢: 102M deaths
- [Mean Age of Preventable Death from Post-Safety Efficacy Delay](#sec-regulatory_delay_mean_age_of_death) 📊: 62 years (SE: ±3 years)
- [Standard Economic Value per QALY](#sec-standard_economic_qaly_value_usd) 📊: $150K (SE: ±$30K)

$$
\begin{gathered}
Loss_{lag} \\
= Deaths_{lag,total} \times (LE_{global} - Age_{death,delay}) \times Value_{QALY} \\
= 102M \times (79 - 62) \times \$150K \\
= \$259T \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Deaths_{lag,total} \\
= Lives_{saved,annual} \times T_{lag} \\
= 12.4M \times 8.2 \\
= 102M \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Lives_{saved,annual} = \frac{LY_{saved,annual}}{T_{ext}} = \frac{149M}{12} = 12.4M
\end{gathered}
$$

**Methodology**: [../appendix/invisible-graveyard#historical-progress](../appendix/invisible-graveyard#historical-progress)

*~ Medium confidence*

### Total Annual Cost of War Worldwide: $11.4T {#sec-global_annual_direct_indirect_war_cost}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Details"}

Total annual cost of war worldwide (direct + indirect costs)

**Inputs**:

- [Total Annual Direct War Costs](#sec-global_annual_war_direct_costs_total) 🔢: $7.66T
- [Total Annual Indirect War Costs](#sec-global_annual_war_indirect_costs_total) 🔢: $3.70T

$$
\begin{gathered}
Cost_{war,total} \\
= Cost_{war,direct} + Cost_{war,indirect} \\
= \$7.66T + \$3.7T \\
= \$11.4T \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{war,direct} \\
= Loss_{life,conflict} + Damage_{infra,total} \\
+ Disruption_{trade} + Spending_{mil} \\
= \$2.45T + \$1.88T + \$616B + \$2.72T \\
= \$7.66T \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Loss_{life,conflict} \\
= Cost_{combat,human} + Cost_{state,human} \\
+ Cost_{terror,human} \\
= \$2.34T + \$27B + \$83B \\
= \$2.45T \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{combat,human} \\
= Deaths_{combat} \times VSL \\
= 234{,}000 \times \$10M \\
= \$2.34T \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{state,human} \\
= Deaths_{state} \times VSL \\
= 2{,}700 \times \$10M \\
= \$27B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{terror,human} \\
= Deaths_{terror} \times VSL \\
= 8{,}300 \times \$10M \\
= \$83B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Damage_{infra,total} \\
= Damage_{comms} + Damage_{edu} + Damage_{energy} \\
+ Damage_{health} + Damage_{transport} \\
+ Damage_{water} \\
= \$298B + \$234B + \$422B + \$166B + \$487B + \$268B \\
= \$1.88T \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Disruption_{trade} \\
= Disruption_{currency} + Disruption_{energy} \\
+ Disruption_{shipping} + Disruption_{supply} \\
= \$57.4B + \$125B + \$247B + \$187B \\
= \$616B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{war,indirect} \\
= Damage_{env} + Loss_{growth,mil} \\
+ Loss_{capital,conflict} + Cost_{psych} \\
+ Cost_{refugee} + Cost_{vet} \\
= \$100B + \$2.72T + \$300B + \$232B + \$150B + \$200B \\
= \$3.7T
\end{gathered}
$$

**Methodology**: [../problem/cost-of-war#total-cost](../problem/cost-of-war#total-cost)

### Medical Research Spending as Percentage of Total Disease Burden: 0.0525% {#sec-medical_research_pct_of_disease_burden}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Details"}

Medical research spending as percentage of total disease burden

**Inputs**:

- [Global Government Medical Research Spending](#sec-global_med_research_spending) 📊: $67.5B (95% CI: $54B - $81B)
- [Total Annual Cost of War and Disease with All Externalities](#sec-global_total_health_and_war_cost_annual) 🔢: $129T

$$
\begin{gathered}
Pct_{RD:burden} \\
= \frac{Spending_{RD}}{Cost_{health+war}} \\
= \frac{\$67.5B}{\$129T} \\
= 0.0525\% \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{health+war} \\
= Cost_{war,total} + Burden_{disease} + Spending_{symptom} \\
= \$11.4T + \$109T + \$8.2T \\
= \$129T \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{war,total} \\
= Cost_{war,direct} + Cost_{war,indirect} \\
= \$7.66T + \$3.7T \\
= \$11.4T \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{war,direct} \\
= Loss_{life,conflict} + Damage_{infra,total} \\
+ Disruption_{trade} + Spending_{mil} \\
= \$2.45T + \$1.88T + \$616B + \$2.72T \\
= \$7.66T \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Loss_{life,conflict} \\
= Cost_{combat,human} + Cost_{state,human} \\
+ Cost_{terror,human} \\
= \$2.34T + \$27B + \$83B \\
= \$2.45T \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{combat,human} \\
= Deaths_{combat} \times VSL \\
= 234{,}000 \times \$10M \\
= \$2.34T \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{state,human} \\
= Deaths_{state} \times VSL \\
= 2{,}700 \times \$10M \\
= \$27B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{terror,human} \\
= Deaths_{terror} \times VSL \\
= 8{,}300 \times \$10M \\
= \$83B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Damage_{infra,total} \\
= Damage_{comms} + Damage_{edu} + Damage_{energy} \\
+ Damage_{health} + Damage_{transport} \\
+ Damage_{water} \\
= \$298B + \$234B + \$422B + \$166B + \$487B + \$268B \\
= \$1.88T \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Disruption_{trade} \\
= Disruption_{currency} + Disruption_{energy} \\
+ Disruption_{shipping} + Disruption_{supply} \\
= \$57.4B + \$125B + \$247B + \$187B \\
= \$616B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{war,indirect} \\
= Damage_{env} + Loss_{growth,mil} \\
+ Loss_{capital,conflict} + Cost_{psych} \\
+ Cost_{refugee} + Cost_{vet} \\
= \$100B + \$2.72T + \$300B + \$232B + \$150B + \$200B \\
= \$3.7T \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Burden_{disease} \\
= Cost_{medical,direct} + Loss_{life,disease} \\
+ Loss_{productivity} \\
= \$9.9T + \$94.2T + \$5T \\
= \$109T
\end{gathered}
$$

**Methodology**: [../economics/1-pct-treaty-impact](../economics/1-pct-treaty-impact)

*✓ High confidence*

### Misallocation Factor: Cost to Kill vs Cost to Save: 2.89k:1 {#sec-misallocation_factor_death_vs_saving}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Details"}

Misallocation factor: cost to kill vs cost to save

**Inputs**:

- [Total Annual Conflict Deaths Globally](#sec-global_annual_conflict_deaths_total) 🔢: 245k deaths/year
- [Total Annual Cost of War Worldwide](#sec-global_annual_direct_indirect_war_cost) 🔢: $11.4T
- [Cost per Life Saved by Medical Research](#sec-global_cost_per_life_saved_med_research_annual) 🔢: $16.1K

$$
\begin{gathered}
k_{misalloc} \\
= \frac{Cost_{war,total}}{Deaths_{conflict} \times Cost_{life,RD}} \\
= \frac{\$11.4T}{245{,}000 \times \$16.1K} \\
= 2{,}890 \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Deaths_{conflict} \\
= Deaths_{combat} + Deaths_{state} + Deaths_{terror} \\
= 234{,}000 + 2{,}700 + 8{,}300 \\
= 245{,}000 \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{war,total} \\
= Cost_{war,direct} + Cost_{war,indirect} \\
= \$7.66T + \$3.7T \\
= \$11.4T \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{war,direct} \\
= Loss_{life,conflict} + Damage_{infra,total} \\
+ Disruption_{trade} + Spending_{mil} \\
= \$2.45T + \$1.88T + \$616B + \$2.72T \\
= \$7.66T \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Loss_{life,conflict} \\
= Cost_{combat,human} + Cost_{state,human} \\
+ Cost_{terror,human} \\
= \$2.34T + \$27B + \$83B \\
= \$2.45T \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{combat,human} \\
= Deaths_{combat} \times VSL \\
= 234{,}000 \times \$10M \\
= \$2.34T \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{state,human} \\
= Deaths_{state} \times VSL \\
= 2{,}700 \times \$10M \\
= \$27B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{terror,human} \\
= Deaths_{terror} \times VSL \\
= 8{,}300 \times \$10M \\
= \$83B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Damage_{infra,total} \\
= Damage_{comms} + Damage_{edu} + Damage_{energy} \\
+ Damage_{health} + Damage_{transport} \\
+ Damage_{water} \\
= \$298B + \$234B + \$422B + \$166B + \$487B + \$268B \\
= \$1.88T \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Disruption_{trade} \\
= Disruption_{currency} + Disruption_{energy} \\
+ Disruption_{shipping} + Disruption_{supply} \\
= \$57.4B + \$125B + \$247B + \$187B \\
= \$616B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{war,indirect} \\
= Damage_{env} + Loss_{growth,mil} \\
+ Loss_{capital,conflict} + Cost_{psych} \\
+ Cost_{refugee} + Cost_{vet} \\
= \$100B + \$2.72T + \$300B + \$232B + \$150B + \$200B \\
= \$3.7T \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{life,RD} = \frac{Spending_{RD}}{Lives_{RD,ann}} = \frac{\$67.5B}{4.2M} = \$16.1K
\end{gathered}
$$

**Methodology**: [../problem/cost-of-war#grotesque-mathematics](../problem/cost-of-war#grotesque-mathematics)

+ Cost_{refugee} + Cost_{vet} \\
= \$100B + \$2.72T + \$300B + \$232B + \$150B + \$200B \\

$$

### Political Dysfunction Tax (Total): 20% {#sec-political_dysfunction_tax_total_pct}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Details"}

Total Political Dysfunction Tax: the welfare loss from governance failures as percentage of potential GDP. Sum of Crony Tax (capture), time-inconsistency, information costs, and coordination failures. Represents the 'tax' citizens implicitly pay for dysfunctional political systems.

**Inputs**:

- [Crony Tax (Capture)](#sec-crony_tax_pct) 📊: 10% (95% CI: 5% - 20%)
- [Time-Inconsistency Tax](#sec-political_dysfunction_tax_time_pct) 📊: 3% (95% CI: 1% - 6%)
- [Information Tax (Hayek)](#sec-political_dysfunction_tax_info_pct) 📊: 2% (95% CI: 1% - 4%)
- [Coordination Tax (Olson)](#sec-political_dysfunction_tax_coordination_pct) 📊: 5% (95% CI: 2% - 10%)

$$
\begin{gathered}
\tau_{dysfunction} \\
= \tau_{crony} + \tau_{time} + \tau_{info} + \tau_{coord} \\
= 10\% + 3\% + 2\% + 5\% \\
= 20\%
\end{gathered}
$$

**Methodology**: [../appendix/optimocracy-paper](../appendix/optimocracy-paper)

*? Low confidence*

### Pragmatic Trial Cost per QALY (RECOVERY): $4.00 {#sec-pragmatic_trial_cost_per_qaly}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Details"}

Cost per QALY for pragmatic platform trials, calculated from RECOVERY trial data. Uses global impact methodology: trial cost divided by total QALYs from downstream adoption. This measures research efficiency (discovery value), not clinical intervention ICER.

**Inputs**:

- [RECOVERY Trial Total Cost](#sec-recovery_trial_total_cost) 📊: $20M (95% CI: $15M - $25M)
- [RECOVERY Trial Total QALYs Generated](#sec-recovery_trial_total_qalys_generated) 🔢: 5.00M QALYs

$$
\begin{gathered}
Cost_{pragmatic,QALY} = \frac{Cost_{RECOVERY}}{QALY_{RECOVERY}} = \frac{\$20M}{5M} = \$4 \\[0.5em]
\text{where } QALY_{RECOVERY} \\
= Lives_{RECOVERY} \times QALY_{COVID} \\
= 1M \times 5 \\
= 5M
\end{gathered}
$$

**Methodology**: [@recovery-trial-82x-cost-reduction]

*~ Medium confidence*

### Pragmatic Trial Efficiency Multiplier vs NIH: 12.5k:1 {#sec-pragmatic_vs_nih_efficiency_multiplier}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Details"}

How many times more cost-effective pragmatic trials are vs standard NIH research. Calculated using global impact methodology (NIH cost per QALY / pragmatic cost per QALY). Shows orders-of-magnitude efficiency gap between discovery-focused pragmatic trials and standard research.

**Inputs**:

- [NIH Standard Research Cost per QALY](#sec-nih_standard_research_cost_per_qaly) 📊: $50K (95% CI: $20K - $100K)
- [Pragmatic Trial Cost per QALY (RECOVERY)](#sec-pragmatic_trial_cost_per_qaly) 🔢: $4.00

$$
\begin{gathered}
k_{pragmatic:NIH} \\
= \frac{Cost_{NIH,QALY}}{Cost_{pragmatic,QALY}} \\
= \frac{\$50K}{\$4} \\
= 12{,}500 \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{pragmatic,QALY} = \frac{Cost_{RECOVERY}}{QALY_{RECOVERY}} = \frac{\$20M}{5M} = \$4 \\[0.5em]
\text{where } QALY_{RECOVERY} \\
= Lives_{RECOVERY} \times QALY_{COVID} \\
= 1M \times 5 \\
= 5M
\end{gathered}
$$

*~ Medium confidence*

### Status Quo Average Years to First Treatment: 222 years {#sec-status_quo_avg_years_to_first_treatment}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Details"}

Average years until first treatment discovered for a typical disease under current system. The average disease is in the middle of the queue, so it waits half the total queue clearance time (~443/2 = ~222 years).

**Inputs**:

- [Status Quo Queue Clearance Time](#sec-status_quo_queue_clearance_years) 🔢: 443 years

$$
\begin{gathered}
T_{first,SQ} = T_{queue,SQ} \times 0.5 = 443 \times 0.5 = 222 \\[0.5em]
\text{where } T_{queue,SQ} = \frac{N_{untreated}}{Treatments_{new,ann}} = \frac{6{,}650}{15} = 443 \\[0.5em]
\text{where } N_{untreated} = N_{rare} \times 0.95 = 7{,}000 \times 0.95 = 6{,}650
\end{gathered}
$$

### Treaty System Benefit Multiplier vs Childhood Vaccination Programs: 11.5:1 {#sec-treaty_benefit_multiplier_vs_vaccines}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Details"}

Treaty system benefit multiplier vs childhood vaccination programs

**Inputs**:

- [Estimated Annual Global Economic Benefit from Childhood Vaccination Programs](#sec-childhood_vaccination_annual_benefit) 📊: $15B (SE: ±$4.50B)
- [Combined Peace and Health Dividends for ROI Calculation](#sec-combined_peace_health_dividends_annual_for_roi_calc) 🔢: $172B

$$
\begin{gathered}
k_{treaty:vax} = \frac{Dividend_{total,ann}}{Benefit_{vax,ann}} = \frac{\$172B}{\$15B} = 11.5 \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Dividend_{total,ann} \\
= Benefit_{peace,soc} + Benefit_{RD,ann} \\
= \$114B + \$58.6B \\
= \$172B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Benefit_{peace,soc} \\
= Cost_{war,total} \times Reduce_{treaty} \\
= \$11.4T \times 1\% \\
= \$114B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{war,total} \\
= Cost_{war,direct} + Cost_{war,indirect} \\
= \$7.66T + \$3.7T \\
= \$11.4T \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{war,direct} \\
= Loss_{life,conflict} + Damage_{infra,total} \\
+ Disruption_{trade} + Spending_{mil} \\
= \$2.45T + \$1.88T + \$616B + \$2.72T \\
= \$7.66T \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Loss_{life,conflict} \\
= Cost_{combat,human} + Cost_{state,human} \\
+ Cost_{terror,human} \\
= \$2.34T + \$27B + \$83B \\
= \$2.45T \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{combat,human} \\
= Deaths_{combat} \times VSL \\
= 234{,}000 \times \$10M \\
= \$2.34T \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{state,human} \\
= Deaths_{state} \times VSL \\
= 2{,}700 \times \$10M \\
= \$27B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{terror,human} \\
= Deaths_{terror} \times VSL \\
= 8{,}300 \times \$10M \\
= \$83B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Damage_{infra,total} \\
= Damage_{comms} + Damage_{edu} + Damage_{energy} \\
+ Damage_{health} + Damage_{transport} \\
+ Damage_{water} \\
= \$298B + \$234B + \$422B + \$166B + \$487B + \$268B \\
= \$1.88T \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Disruption_{trade} \\
= Disruption_{currency} + Disruption_{energy} \\
+ Disruption_{shipping} + Disruption_{supply} \\
= \$57.4B + \$125B + \$247B + \$187B \\
= \$616B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{war,indirect} \\
= Damage_{env} + Loss_{growth,mil} \\
+ Loss_{capital,conflict} + Cost_{psych} \\
+ Cost_{refugee} + Cost_{vet} \\
= \$100B + \$2.72T + \$300B + \$232B + \$150B + \$200B \\
= \$3.7T \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Benefit_{RD,ann} \\
= Spending_{trials} \times Reduce_{pct} \\
= \$60B \times 97.7\% \\
= \$58.6B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Reduce_{pct} \\
= 1 - \frac{Cost_{pragmatic,pt}}{Cost_{P3,pt}} \\
= 1 - \frac{\$929}{\$41K} \\
= 97.7\%
\end{gathered}
$$

**Methodology**: [../economics/1-pct-treaty-impact#better-than-the-best-charities](../economics/1-pct-treaty-impact#better-than-the-best-charities)

*✓ High confidence*

### Cost per DALY Averted (Elimination of Efficacy Lag Plus Earlier Treatment Discovery from Increased Trial Throughput): $0.0018 {#sec-treaty_cost_per_daly_trial_capacity_plus_efficacy_lag}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Details"}

Cost per DALY averted from elimination of efficacy lag plus earlier treatment discovery from increased trial throughput. Only counts campaign cost; ignores economic benefits from funding and R&D savings.

**Inputs**:

- [Total 1% Treaty Campaign Cost](#sec-treaty_campaign_total_cost) 🔢: $1B
- [Total DALYs from Elimination of Efficacy Lag Plus Earlier Treatment Discovery from Higher Trial Throughput](#sec-dfda_trial_capacity_plus_efficacy_lag_dalys) 🔢: 565B DALYs

$$
\begin{gathered}
Cost_{treaty,DALY} = \frac{Cost_{campaign}}{DALYs_{max}} = \frac{\$1B}{565B} = \$0.00177 \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{campaign} \\
= Budget_{viral,base} + Budget_{lobby,treaty} \\
+ Budget_{reserve} \\
= \$250M + \$650M + \$100M \\
= \$1B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } DALYs_{max} \\
= DALYs_{global,ann} \times Pct_{avoid,DALY} \times T_{accel,max} \\
= 2.88B \times 92.6\% \times 212 \\
= 565B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } T_{accel,max} = T_{accel} + T_{lag} = 204 + 8.2 = 212 \\[0.5em]
\text{where } T_{accel} \\
= T_{first,SQ} \times \left(1 - \frac{1}{k_{capacity}}\right) \\
= 222 \times \left(1 - \frac{1}{12.3}\right) \\
= 204 \\[0.5em]
\text{where } T_{first,SQ} = T_{queue,SQ} \times 0.5 = 443 \times 0.5 = 222 \\[0.5em]
\text{where } T_{queue,SQ} = \frac{N_{untreated}}{Treatments_{new,ann}} = \frac{6{,}650}{15} = 443 \\[0.5em]
\text{where } N_{untreated} = N_{rare} \times 0.95 = 7{,}000 \times 0.95 = 6{,}650 \\[0.5em]
\text{where } k_{capacity} = \frac{N_{fundable,ann}}{Slots_{curr}} = \frac{23.4M}{1.9M} = 12.3 \\[0.5em]
\text{where } N_{fundable,ann} \\
= \frac{Subsidies_{trial,ann}}{Cost_{pragmatic,pt}} \\
= \frac{\$21.7B}{\$929} \\
= 23.4M \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Subsidies_{trial,ann} \\
= Treasury_{RD,ann} - OPEX_{dFDA} \\
= \$21.8B - \$40M \\
= \$21.7B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } OPEX_{dFDA} \\
= Cost_{platform} + Cost_{staff} + Cost_{infra} \\
+ Cost_{regulatory} + Cost_{community} \\
= \$15M + \$10M + \$8M + \$5M + \$2M \\
= \$40M \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Treasury_{RD,ann} \\
= Funding_{treaty} - Payout_{bond,ann} - Funding_{political,ann} \\
= \$27.2B - \$2.72B - \$2.72B \\
= \$21.8B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{treaty} \\
= Spending_{mil} \times Reduce_{treaty} \\
= \$2.72T \times 1\% \\
= \$27.2B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Payout_{bond,ann} \\
= Funding_{treaty} \times Pct_{bond} \\
= \$27.2B \times 10\% \\
= \$2.72B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{treaty} \\
= Spending_{mil} \times Reduce_{treaty} \\
= \$2.72T \times 1\% \\
= \$27.2B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{political,ann} \\
= Funding_{treaty} \times Pct_{political} \\
= \$27.2B \times 10\% \\
= \$2.72B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{treaty} \\
= Spending_{mil} \times Reduce_{treaty} \\
= \$2.72T \times 1\% \\
= \$27.2B
\end{gathered}
$$

**Methodology**: [../appendix/dfda-impact-paper](../appendix/dfda-impact-paper)

*✓ High confidence*

### Expected Cost per DALY (Risk-Adjusted): $0.177 {#sec-treaty_expected_cost_per_daly}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Details"}

Expected cost per DALY accounting for political success probability uncertainty. Monte Carlo samples from beta(0.1%, 10%) distribution. At the conservative 1% estimate, this is still more cost-effective than bed nets ($89.0/DALY).

**Inputs**:

- [Cost per DALY Averted (Elimination of Efficacy Lag Plus Earlier Treatment Discovery from Increased Trial Throughput)](#sec-treaty_cost_per_daly_trial_capacity_plus_efficacy_lag) 🔢: $0.0018
- [Political Success Probability](#sec-political_success_probability) 📊: 1% (95% CI: 0.1% - 10%)

$$
\begin{gathered}
E[Cost_{DALY}] = \frac{Cost_{treaty,DALY}}{P_{success}} = \frac{\$0.00177}{1\%} = \$0.177 \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{treaty,DALY} = \frac{Cost_{campaign}}{DALYs_{max}} = \frac{\$1B}{565B} = \$0.00177 \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{campaign} \\
= Budget_{viral,base} + Budget_{lobby,treaty} \\
+ Budget_{reserve} \\
= \$250M + \$650M + \$100M \\
= \$1B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } DALYs_{max} \\
= DALYs_{global,ann} \times Pct_{avoid,DALY} \times T_{accel,max} \\
= 2.88B \times 92.6\% \times 212 \\
= 565B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } T_{accel,max} = T_{accel} + T_{lag} = 204 + 8.2 = 212 \\[0.5em]
\text{where } T_{accel} \\
= T_{first,SQ} \times \left(1 - \frac{1}{k_{capacity}}\right) \\
= 222 \times \left(1 - \frac{1}{12.3}\right) \\
= 204 \\[0.5em]
\text{where } T_{first,SQ} = T_{queue,SQ} \times 0.5 = 443 \times 0.5 = 222 \\[0.5em]
\text{where } T_{queue,SQ} = \frac{N_{untreated}}{Treatments_{new,ann}} = \frac{6{,}650}{15} = 443 \\[0.5em]
\text{where } N_{untreated} = N_{rare} \times 0.95 = 7{,}000 \times 0.95 = 6{,}650 \\[0.5em]
\text{where } k_{capacity} = \frac{N_{fundable,ann}}{Slots_{curr}} = \frac{23.4M}{1.9M} = 12.3 \\[0.5em]
\text{where } N_{fundable,ann} \\
= \frac{Subsidies_{trial,ann}}{Cost_{pragmatic,pt}} \\
= \frac{\$21.7B}{\$929} \\
= 23.4M \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Subsidies_{trial,ann} \\
= Treasury_{RD,ann} - OPEX_{dFDA} \\
= \$21.8B - \$40M \\
= \$21.7B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } OPEX_{dFDA} \\
= Cost_{platform} + Cost_{staff} + Cost_{infra} \\
+ Cost_{regulatory} + Cost_{community} \\
= \$15M + \$10M + \$8M + \$5M + \$2M \\
= \$40M \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Treasury_{RD,ann} \\
= Funding_{treaty} - Payout_{bond,ann} - Funding_{political,ann} \\
= \$27.2B - \$2.72B - \$2.72B \\
= \$21.8B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{treaty} \\
= Spending_{mil} \times Reduce_{treaty} \\
= \$2.72T \times 1\% \\
= \$27.2B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Payout_{bond,ann} \\
= Funding_{treaty} \times Pct_{bond} \\
= \$27.2B \times 10\% \\
= \$2.72B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{treaty} \\
= Spending_{mil} \times Reduce_{treaty} \\
= \$2.72T \times 1\% \\
= \$27.2B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{political,ann} \\
= Funding_{treaty} \times Pct_{political} \\
= \$27.2B \times 10\% \\
= \$2.72B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{treaty} \\
= Spending_{mil} \times Reduce_{treaty} \\
= \$2.72T \times 1\% \\
= \$27.2B
\end{gathered}
$$

**Methodology**: [../appendix/dfda-impact-paper](../appendix/dfda-impact-paper)

### 1% treaty Basic Annual Benefits (Peace + R&D Savings): $172B {#sec-treaty_peace_plus_rd_annual_benefits}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Details"}

Basic annual benefits: peace dividend + Decentralized Framework for Drug Assessment R&D savings only (2 of 8 benefit categories, excludes regulatory delay value)

**Inputs**:

- [Annual Peace Dividend from 1% Reduction in Total War Costs](#sec-peace_dividend_annual_societal_benefit) 🔢: $114B
- [Decentralized Framework for Drug Assessment Annual Benefit: R&D Savings](#sec-dfda_benefit_rd_only_annual) 🔢: $58.6B

$$
\begin{gathered}
Benefit_{peace+RD} \\
= Benefit_{peace,soc} + Benefit_{RD,ann} \\
= \$114B + \$58.6B \\
= \$172B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Benefit_{peace,soc} \\
= Cost_{war,total} \times Reduce_{treaty} \\
= \$11.4T \times 1\% \\
= \$114B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{war,total} \\
= Cost_{war,direct} + Cost_{war,indirect} \\
= \$7.66T + \$3.7T \\
= \$11.4T \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{war,direct} \\
= Loss_{life,conflict} + Damage_{infra,total} \\
+ Disruption_{trade} + Spending_{mil} \\
= \$2.45T + \$1.88T + \$616B + \$2.72T \\
= \$7.66T \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Loss_{life,conflict} \\
= Cost_{combat,human} + Cost_{state,human} \\
+ Cost_{terror,human} \\
= \$2.34T + \$27B + \$83B \\
= \$2.45T \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{combat,human} \\
= Deaths_{combat} \times VSL \\
= 234{,}000 \times \$10M \\
= \$2.34T \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{state,human} \\
= Deaths_{state} \times VSL \\
= 2{,}700 \times \$10M \\
= \$27B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{terror,human} \\
= Deaths_{terror} \times VSL \\
= 8{,}300 \times \$10M \\
= \$83B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Damage_{infra,total} \\
= Damage_{comms} + Damage_{edu} + Damage_{energy} \\
+ Damage_{health} + Damage_{transport} \\
+ Damage_{water} \\
= \$298B + \$234B + \$422B + \$166B + \$487B + \$268B \\
= \$1.88T \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Disruption_{trade} \\
= Disruption_{currency} + Disruption_{energy} \\
+ Disruption_{shipping} + Disruption_{supply} \\
= \$57.4B + \$125B + \$247B + \$187B \\
= \$616B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{war,indirect} \\
= Damage_{env} + Loss_{growth,mil} \\
+ Loss_{capital,conflict} + Cost_{psych} \\
+ Cost_{refugee} + Cost_{vet} \\
= \$100B + \$2.72T + \$300B + \$232B + \$150B + \$200B \\
= \$3.7T \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Benefit_{RD,ann} \\
= Spending_{trials} \times Reduce_{pct} \\
= \$60B \times 97.7\% \\
= \$58.6B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Reduce_{pct} \\
= 1 - \frac{Cost_{pragmatic,pt}}{Cost_{P3,pt}} \\
= 1 - \frac{\$929}{\$41K} \\
= 97.7\%
\end{gathered}
$$

**Methodology**: [../appendix/parameters-and-calculations#sec-treaty_peace_plus_rd_annual_benefits](../appendix/parameters-and-calculations#sec-treaty_peace_plus_rd_annual_benefits)

*✓ High confidence*

Treaty ROI based on historical rate of drug development (existing drugs only). Total one-time benefit from avoiding regulatory delay for drugs already in development divided by $1B campaign cost. Excludes future innovation effects.

**Inputs**:

- [Total Economic Loss from Historical Progress Delays](#sec-existing_drugs_efficacy_lag_economic_loss) 🔢: $259T
- [Total 1% Treaty Campaign Cost](#sec-treaty_campaign_total_cost) 🔢: $1B

$$
\begin{gathered}
ROI_{drugs} = \frac{Loss_{lag}}{Cost_{campaign}} = \frac{\$259T}{\$1B} = 259{,}000 \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Loss_{lag} \\
= Deaths_{lag,total} \times (LE_{global} - Age_{death,delay}) \times Value_{QALY} \\
= 102M \times (79 - 62) \times \$150K \\
= \$259T \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Deaths_{lag,total} \\
= Lives_{saved,annual} \times T_{lag} \\
= 12.4M \times 8.2 \\
= 102M \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Lives_{saved,annual} = \frac{LY_{saved,annual}}{T_{ext}} = \frac{149M}{12} = 12.4M \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{campaign} \\
= Budget_{viral,base} + Budget_{lobby,treaty} \\
+ Budget_{reserve} \\
= \$250M + \$650M + \$100M \\
= \$1B
\end{gathered}
$$

### Treaty ROI - Elimination of Efficacy Lag Plus Earlier Treatment Discovery from Increased Trial Throughput: 84.8M:1 {#sec-treaty_roi_trial_capacity_plus_efficacy_lag}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Details"}

Treaty ROI from elimination of efficacy lag plus earlier treatment discovery from increased trial throughput. Total one-time benefit divided by campaign cost. This is the primary ROI estimate for total health benefits.

**Inputs**:

- [Total Economic Benefit from Elimination of Efficacy Lag Plus Earlier Treatment Discovery from Higher Trial Throughput](#sec-dfda_trial_capacity_plus_efficacy_lag_economic_value) 🔢: $84.8 quadrillion
- [Total 1% Treaty Campaign Cost](#sec-treaty_campaign_total_cost) 🔢: $1B

$$
\begin{gathered}
ROI_{max} = \frac{Value_{max}}{Cost_{campaign}} = \frac{\$84800T}{\$1B} = 84.8M \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Value_{max} \\
= DALYs_{max} \times Value_{QALY} \\
= 565B \times \$150K \\
= \$84800T \\[0.5em]
\text{where } DALYs_{max} \\
= DALYs_{global,ann} \times Pct_{avoid,DALY} \times T_{accel,max} \\
= 2.88B \times 92.6\% \times 212 \\
= 565B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } T_{accel,max} = T_{accel} + T_{lag} = 204 + 8.2 = 212 \\[0.5em]
\text{where } T_{accel} \\
= T_{first,SQ} \times \left(1 - \frac{1}{k_{capacity}}\right) \\
= 222 \times \left(1 - \frac{1}{12.3}\right) \\
= 204 \\[0.5em]
\text{where } T_{first,SQ} = T_{queue,SQ} \times 0.5 = 443 \times 0.5 = 222 \\[0.5em]
\text{where } T_{queue,SQ} = \frac{N_{untreated}}{Treatments_{new,ann}} = \frac{6{,}650}{15} = 443 \\[0.5em]
\text{where } N_{untreated} = N_{rare} \times 0.95 = 7{,}000 \times 0.95 = 6{,}650 \\[0.5em]
\text{where } k_{capacity} = \frac{N_{fundable,ann}}{Slots_{curr}} = \frac{23.4M}{1.9M} = 12.3 \\[0.5em]
\text{where } N_{fundable,ann} \\
= \frac{Subsidies_{trial,ann}}{Cost_{pragmatic,pt}} \\
= \frac{\$21.7B}{\$929} \\
= 23.4M \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Subsidies_{trial,ann} \\
= Treasury_{RD,ann} - OPEX_{dFDA} \\
= \$21.8B - \$40M \\
= \$21.7B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } OPEX_{dFDA} \\
= Cost_{platform} + Cost_{staff} + Cost_{infra} \\
+ Cost_{regulatory} + Cost_{community} \\
= \$15M + \$10M + \$8M + \$5M + \$2M \\
= \$40M \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Treasury_{RD,ann} \\
= Funding_{treaty} - Payout_{bond,ann} - Funding_{political,ann} \\
= \$27.2B - \$2.72B - \$2.72B \\
= \$21.8B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{treaty} \\
= Spending_{mil} \times Reduce_{treaty} \\
= \$2.72T \times 1\% \\
= \$27.2B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Payout_{bond,ann} \\
= Funding_{treaty} \times Pct_{bond} \\
= \$27.2B \times 10\% \\
= \$2.72B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{treaty} \\
= Spending_{mil} \times Reduce_{treaty} \\
= \$2.72T \times 1\% \\
= \$27.2B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{political,ann} \\
= Funding_{treaty} \times Pct_{political} \\
= \$27.2B \times 10\% \\
= \$2.72B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{treaty} \\
= Spending_{mil} \times Reduce_{treaty} \\
= \$2.72T \times 1\% \\
= \$27.2B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{campaign} \\
= Budget_{viral,base} + Budget_{lobby,treaty} \\
+ Budget_{reserve} \\
= \$250M + \$650M + \$100M \\
= \$1B
\end{gathered}
$$

\text{where } k_{capacity} = \frac{N_{fundable,ann}}{Slots_{curr}} = \frac{23.4M}{1.9M} = 12.3 \\[0.5em]
\text{where } N_{fundable,ann} \\
= \frac{Subsidies_{trial,ann}}{Cost_{pragmatic,pt}} \\
= \frac{\$21.7B}{\$929} \\
= 23.4M \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Subsidies_{trial,ann} \\
= Treasury_{RD,ann} - OPEX_{dFDA} \\
= \$21.8B - \$40M \\
= \$21.7B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } OPEX_{dFDA} \\
= Cost_{platform} + Cost_{staff} + Cost_{infra} \\
+ Cost_{regulatory} + Cost_{community} \\
= \$15M + \$10M + \$8M + \$5M + \$2M \\
= \$40M \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Treasury_{RD,ann} \\
= Funding_{treaty} - Payout_{bond,ann} - Funding_{political,ann} \\
= \$27.2B - \$2.72B - \$2.72B \\
= \$21.8B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{treaty} \\
= Spending_{mil} \times Reduce_{treaty} \\
= \$2.72T \times 1\% \\
= \$27.2B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Payout_{bond,ann} \\
= Funding_{treaty} \times Pct_{bond} \\
= \$27.2B \times 10\% \\
= \$2.72B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{treaty} \\
= Spending_{mil} \times Reduce_{treaty} \\
= \$2.72T \times 1\% \\
= \$27.2B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{political,ann} \\
= Funding_{treaty} \times Pct_{political} \\
= \$27.2B \times 10\% \\
= \$2.72B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Funding_{treaty} \\
= Spending_{mil} \times Reduce_{treaty} \\
= \$2.72T \times 1\% \\
= \$27.2B
\end{gathered}
$$

*✓ High confidence*

### Ratio of Type Ii Error Cost to Type I Error Benefit: 3.07k:1 {#sec-type_ii_error_cost_ratio}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Details"}

Ratio of Type II error cost to Type I error benefit (harm from delay vs. harm prevented)

**Inputs**:

- [Total DALYs Lost from Disease Eradication Delay](#sec-dfda_efficacy_lag_elimination_dalys) 🔢: 7.94B DALYs
- [Maximum DALYs Saved by FDA Preventing Unsafe Drugs (1962-2024)](#sec-type_i_error_benefit_dalys) 🔢: 2.59M DALYs

$$
\begin{gathered}
Ratio_{TypeII} = \frac{DALYs_{lag}}{DALY_{TypeI}} = \frac{7.94B}{2.59M} = 3{,}070 \\[0.5em]
\text{where } DALYs_{lag} = YLL_{lag} + YLD_{lag} = 7.07B + 873M = 7.94B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } YLL_{lag} \\
= Deaths_{lag} \times (LE_{global} - Age_{death,delay}) \\
= 416M \times (79 - 62) \\
= 7.07B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Deaths_{lag} \\
= T_{lag} \times Deaths_{disease,daily} \times 338 \\
= 8.2 \times 150{,}000 \times 338 \\
= 416M \\[0.5em]
\text{where } YLD_{lag} \\
= Deaths_{lag} \times T_{suffering} \times DW_{chronic} \\
= 416M \times 6 \times 0.35 \\
= 873M \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Deaths_{lag} \\
= T_{lag} \times Deaths_{disease,daily} \times 338 \\
= 8.2 \times 150{,}000 \times 338 \\
= 416M \\[0.5em]
\text{where } DALY_{TypeI} = DALY_{thal} \times 62 = 41{,}800 \times 62 = 2.59M \\[0.5em]
\text{where } DALY_{thal} \\
= YLD_{thal} + YLL_{thal} \\
= 13{,}000 + 28{,}800 \\
= 41{,}800 \\[0.5em]
\text{where } YLD_{thal} \\
= DW_{thal} \times N_{thal,survive} \times LE_{thal} \\
= 0.4 \times 540 \times 60 \\
= 13{,}000 \\[0.5em]
\text{where } N_{thal,survive} \\
= N_{thal,US,prevent} \times (1 - Rate_{thal,mort}) \\
= 900 \times (1 - 40\%) \\
= 540 \\[0.5em]
\text{where } N_{thal,US,prevent} \\
= N_{thal,global} \times Pct_{US,1960} \\
= 15{,}000 \times 6\% \\
= 900 \\[0.5em]
\text{where } YLL_{thal} = Deaths_{thal} \times 80 = 360 \times 80 = 28{,}800 \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Deaths_{thal} \\
= Rate_{thal,mort} \times N_{thal,US,prevent} \\
= 40\% \times 900 \\
= 360 \\[0.5em]
\text{where } N_{thal,US,prevent} \\
= N_{thal,global} \times Pct_{US,1960} \\
= 15{,}000 \times 6\% \\
= 900
\end{gathered}
$$

**Methodology**: [../appendix/invisible-graveyard#risk-analysis](../appendix/invisible-graveyard#risk-analysis)

*~ Medium confidence*

#### Sensitivity Analysis

{{< include ../figures/sensitivity-table-type_ii_error_cost_ratio.qmd >}}

### Healthcare System Inefficiency: $1.20T {#sec-bad_policy_cost_us_healthcare_inefficiency}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Details"}

US healthcare spending inefficiency. US spends ~$4.5T/yr (18% GDP) vs 9-11% in comparable OECD countries with similar/better outcomes. Papanicolas et al. (2018 JAMA) and multiple studies document $1-1.5T in excess spending from administrative complexity, high prices, and poor care coordination. Very high economist consensus.

### Bed Nets Cost per DALY: $89 {#sec-bed_nets_cost_per_daly}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Details"}

GiveWell cost per DALY for insecticide-treated bed nets (midpoint estimate, range $78-100). DALYs (Disability-Adjusted Life Years) measure disease burden by combining years of life lost and years lived with disability. Bed nets prevent malaria deaths and are considered a gold standard benchmark for cost-effective global health interventions - if an intervention costs less per DALY than bed nets, it's exceptionally cost-effective. GiveWell synthesizes peer-reviewed academic research with transparent, rigorous methodology and extensive external expert review.

**Source**: [@givewell-cost-per-life-saved]

#### Uncertainty Range

**Technical**: 95% CI: [$78, $100] • Distribution: Normal

## Core Definitions {#sec-definitions}

Fundamental parameters and constants used throughout the analysis.

### ADAPTABLE Trial Patients Enrolled: 15.1k patients {#sec-adaptable_trial_patients}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Details"}

Patients enrolled in ADAPTABLE trial (PCORnet 2016-2019). Enrolled across 40 clinical sites. Precise count from trial completion records.

Unique approved drug-disease pairings (FDA-approved uses, midpoint of 1,500-2,000 range)

#### Uncertainty Range

**Technical**: 95% CI: [1.50k pairings, 2.00k pairings] • Distribution: Uniform

**What this means**: This estimate has moderate uncertainty. The true value likely falls between 1.50k pairings and 2.00k pairings (±14%). This represents a reasonable range that our Monte Carlo simulations account for when calculating overall uncertainty in the results.

*The uniform distribution means any value in the range is equally likely.*

*Core definition*

:::

### Average Life Extension per Beneficiary: 12 years {#sec-avg_life_extension_per_beneficiary}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Details"}

Average years of life extension per person saved by pharmaceutical interventions. Assumption used to convert life-years saved to approximate lives saved. Based on Lichtenberg's methodology where life-years are calculated from Years of Life Lost (YLL) reductions.

```{=html}
<script>
// Conservative lazy loading: only load images actually in viewport
(function() {
  'use strict';
  
  let imageObserver = null;
  let loadTimeout = null;
  
  function enableLazyLoading() {
    const images = document.querySelectorAll('img');
    
    // Use Intersection Observer with conservative threshold
    // rootMargin: '50px' means only load images within 50px of viewport
    // This prevents loading images passed through during hash navigation
    imageObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries, observer) => {
      entries.forEach(entry => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting && entry.intersectionRatio > 0) {
          const img = entry.target;
          // Only load if image is actually visible (not just passed through)
          if (img.dataset.src) {
            img.src = img.dataset.src;
            img.removeAttribute('data-src');
          } else if (!img.hasAttribute('loading')) {
            // For images without data-src, use native lazy loading
            img.setAttribute('loading', 'lazy');
          }
          observer.unobserve(img);
        }
      });
    }, {
      rootMargin: '50px',  // Only load images within 50px of viewport
      threshold: 0.01      // Trigger when at least 1% visible
    });
    
    images.forEach(img => {
      imageObserver.observe(img);
    });
  }
  
  // Handle hash navigation (clicking links to sections)
  // Delay loading to avoid loading images passed through during jump
  function handleHashNavigation() {
    if (loadTimeout) clearTimeout(loadTimeout);
    // Wait 300ms after navigation to let scroll settle
    // Images will load naturally via Intersection Observer when visible
    loadTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
      // Scroll has settled, Intersection Observer will handle visible images
      // No action needed - observer is already watching
    }, 300);
  }
  
  // Initialize on page load
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', enableLazyLoading);
  } else {
    enableLazyLoading();
  }
  
  // Handle hash changes (clicking anchor links)
  window.addEventListener('hashchange', handleHashNavigation);
  
  // Also handle initial hash if page loads with one
  if (window.location.hash) {
    setTimeout(handleHashNavigation, 100);
  }
})();
</script>
```
